name: Terry's Quality Concrete

items.title: No phone number on the homepage
items.detail: We couldn't find your phone number anywhere on the homepage, as text or as a tap-to-call link.
items.fix: Show your number in the header and make it a tap-to-call link, so a phone visitor reaches you in one tap.
items.fixTitle: Put a tap-to-call button at the top

items.title: No Google Analytics
items.detail: We couldn't find Google Analytics on the site, so it's hard to tell which visits turn into calls.
items.fix: Add Google Analytics, and count calls and form fills as conversions, so you can see which visits and ads bring in jobs.

items.title: The homepage is heavy on a phone
items.detail: The homepage is about 4.6 MB on a phone, mostly photos, where fast sites stay under 3 MB.
items.fix: Resize and compress the photos (and load the ones further down only when needed), so the page opens fast on cell data.
